question: Who has assumed charge as the new Mines Secretary of India, succeeding V.L. Kantha Rao in September 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Piyush Goyal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **IAS officer Piyush Goyal (1994 batch, Nagaland cadre) assumed charge as the new Mines Secretary, succeeding V.L. Kantha Rao.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Piyush Goyal is a 1994-batch IAS officer of the Nagaland cadre.**
 
• **He previously served as the CEO of NATGRID under the Ministry of Home Affairs.**
 
• **He succeeds V.L. Kantha Rao as Secretary, Ministry of Mines.**
 
• **His role is vital as India’s mining sector faces growing demand for critical minerals like lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earths.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Critical Minerals__

 __
 
• Include lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earth elements.
 
• Essential for EVs, renewable energy technologies, and advanced manufacturing.
 
• Securing supply is crucial for India’s energy transition and net-zero targets.
 
 
 
• NATGRID__
 
 
• National Intelligence Grid under Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• Integrates data from multiple agencies for counter-terrorism and national security.
 
• Piyush Goyal served as its CEO before his new role.
